subject: maths
question: If both the radius and height of a right circular cone are increased by 25%, its volume will be increased by: (Approximation up to two decimal points) (Where pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

If both the radius and height of a right circular cone are increased by 25%, its volume will be increased by:

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone, V = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculation:**

Initial volume, V₁ = (1/3)πr²h

New radius, r' = r × 1.25

New height, h' = h × 1.25

New volume, V₂ = (1/3)π(r × 1.25)²(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)π(r² × 1.25²)(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)π(r² × 1.5625)(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)πr²h × 1.953125

⇒ V₂ = V₁ × 1.953125

Increase in volume = V₂ - V₁

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ × 1.953125 - V₁

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ (1.953125 - 1)

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ × 0.953125

⇒ Percentage increase in volume = 0.953125 × 100%

⇒ Percentage increase in volume ≈ 95.31%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
